newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: GOLF-FALDO TO CHASE RYDER CUP POINTS IN AUSTRALIA.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-FALDO TO CHASE RYDER CUP POINTS IN AUSTRALIA.

text.p: U.S. Masters champion Nick Faldo will begin his 1997 pursuit of European Ryder Cup team points in Australia next year by playing in the Johnnie Walker Classic in January, tournament organisers said on Tuesday.

The 1997 European Tour begins with the A$1.4 million (US$1.12 million) Classic at Hope Island in Queensland from January 23 to 26 and the Heineken Classic in Perth the following week before moving to South Africa for three events in February.

Organisers of the Johnnie Walker Classic told reporters Britain's Faldo would play their event in place of world number one Greg Norman, who said on Monday he was taking three months off golf to recover from a back injury.
"Nick Faldo is one of the finest players in the game and we are delighted he is playing," tournament official Steve Foxcroft said.

World number three Faldo will join fellow leading European Ryder Cup team contenders Colin Montgomerie and Ian Woosnam, South Africa's Ernie Els and Americans Fred Couples and John Daly at Hope Island.
Norman, who won his fifth Australian Open title on Sunday, said he would stop playing after appearing in his own tournament, The Greg Norman Classic, starting in Melbourne on Thursday.
